46:2: The sending down of the Book is from Allah, al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
46:3: We did not create the heavens, the earth, and what is between the two except with truth and for a specified term. But those who disbelieve turn away from that of which they are warned.
46:4: Say: Have you seen those you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth? Or do they have a partnership in the heavens? Bring me a book before this or a trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.
46:5: And who is more astray than one who prays to those besides Allah who cannot answer him until the Day of Resurrection? While they are unaware of their prayer.
46:6: And whenever people were gathered, they were enemies to them and were deniers of their worship.
46:7: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, those who disbelieved said when the truth came to them: 'This is clear magic.'
46:8: Or do they say: 'He invented it'? Say: If I invented it, you possess nothing for me (to come) from Allah; He knows best that in which you are immersed; He is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
46:9: Say: I was not an innovation (a novelty) among the messengers. I do not know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow what is revealed to me. I am only a clear warner.
46:10: Say: Have you seen, if it is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel testified to the like of it and believed, while you were arrogant? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
46:11: And those who disbelieved said to those who believed: If (this) had been a good, they would not have preceded us to it. And when they were not guided by it, behold, they will say: This is an old slander.
46:12: And before it, the book of Moses was a leader and a mercy. And this is a Book confirming in an Arabic tongue, to warn those who do wrong and as glad tidings for the doers of good.
46:13: Indeed, those who say: 'Our Rabb is Allah', then remain upright, there will be no fear upon them, nor will they grieve.
46:14: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein, as a reward for what they used to do.
46:15: We enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty and gave birth to him with difficulty. His carrying and his weaning is thirty months. Until, when he reached his full strength and reached forty years, he said: My Rabb! Inspire me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteous work that You will be pleased with. And rectify my offspring for me. Indeed, I have repented to You and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
46:16: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, they are among the companions of Paradise.
46:17: As for the one who said to his parents: 'Fie upon you! Do you threaten me that I will be brought forth, while generations have already passed away before me?' while the two of them call upon Allah for help: 'Woe to you! Believe, indeed, the promise of Allah is true.' And he says: 'This is nothing but tales of the ancients.'
46:18: Those are the ones upon whom the word has proven true among communities of jinn and men who have passed away before them.
46:19: And for each there are degrees according to what they did, and so that their deeds may be paid to them in full, and they will not be wronged.
46:20: And the Day those who disbelieved are presented to the Fire, it will be said to them: 'You exhausted your pleasant things in your worldly life and enjoyed yourselves with them. So today you will be recompensed with the humiliating punishment because you were being arrogant on the earth without right and because you were acting defiantly.'
46:21: And mention the brother of Ad, when he warned his people in al-Ahqaf, and warners had already passed away before him and after him: 'Do not worship any other than Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.'
46:22: They said: 'Have you come to turn us away from our deities? Then bring us what you promise us, if you are of the truthful.'
46:23: He said: Knowledge is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I have been sent, but I see you are a people behaving ignorantly.
46:24: Until, when they saw it as a cloud spreading toward their valleys, they said: 'This is a cloud that will bring us rain.' Nay, it is that which you sought to hasten.
46:25: It destroys everything by the command of its Rabb. Thus when morning came upon them, nothing could be seen except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense a guilty people.
46:26: And certainly We had established them in things in which We have not established you, and We made for them hearing, eyes, and hearts. But their hearing, their eyes, and their hearts did not benefit them in anything, because they were denying the signs of Allah, and that which they used to mock encompassed them.
46:27: And certainly We destroyed many cities around you, and We varied the signs so that perhaps they might return.
46:28: Then why did the deities they took besides Allah for nearness not help them? On the contrary, they strayed away from them. And that is their slander and what they were inventing.
46:29: And when We directed toward you a group of jinn to listen to the Quran. When they were present for it, they said: 'Be silent!' Then when it was finished, they returned to their people as warners.
46:30: They said: O our people! Indeed, we have listened to a Book sent down after Moses, confirming what was before it, guiding to the truth and to a straight path.
46:31: O our people! Respond to the one who invites to Allah and believe in him, so that He will forgive you of your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
46:32: Whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah is not an escaper (from Allah) on earth, and there are no protectors for him besides Him. Those are in clear error.
46:33: Did they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and was not tired by creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes, indeed He is capable of all things.
46:34: The Day those who disbelieved are presented to the Fire, it will be said: 'Was this not the truth?' They will say: 'Yes, by our Rabb, it was.' He will say: 'Then taste the punishment because of what you used to deny!'
46:35: So be patient just as the possessors of resolve among the messengers were patient, and do not be hasty for them; the Day they see that which they are promised, it will be as if they had not remained except for an hour of a day; this is a notification, then will any be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
